briefs.findings: The core package declares index.ts as its export (packages/core/package.json:1); index.ts:1 re-exports price from storage, whose implementation returns 12 (packages/core/internal/database.ts:1). public.ts:1 uses that interface. In contrast ui.ts:1 and routes.ts:1 directly import storage internals, and alias.ts:1 uses @storage/database, mapped to core/internal by tsconfig.json:11. Those source dependencies conflict with DESIGN.md:3 and AGENTS.md:1. checkout fetches a service price and passes it to postOrder (ui.ts:3); postOrder computes quantity pricing with a discount above five, appends a total to a module-local array, and returns status 201 (routes.ts:2). a.ts:1 and b.ts:1 show reciprocal imports and calls; runtime reachability is not established. Unit sources assert public price 12 and checkout with mocked price 10 (unit.test.mjs:5). The local HTTP journey supplies price 12 but asserts total 10 (journey.mjs:6, journey.mjs:12), matching DESIGN.md:4 only in its assertion. Static reading suggests a mismatch; no failure is claimed as executed.
